title: 第十八章 赵冲出战扬言讨公道第十七章 连胜晋级众人抱团算计
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 第二天清晨，星澜宗广场上人山人海。
十六强名单在告示栏上一字排开，杨卤的名字赫然在列，排在第十一位。旁边标注着他此前的战绩——五战全胜，全无败绩。
围观的弟子们看着这个名字，表情复杂。
有人咬牙切齿，有人难以置信，有人已经开始在盘算着怎么诅咒他了。
而就在此时，一道身影从人群中大步走出，径直走向告示栏前的高台。
赵冲。
他穿着一身深蓝色的劲装，双拳紧握，目光凌厉，周身散发着一股凌厉的战意。他的出现，立刻引起了所有人的注意。
“赵师兄来了！”
“他今天要打谁？十六强名单出来了，他对的是谁？”
“我好像记得……赵师兄对的是刘能？那家伙运气真差啊。”
“那杨卤对的是谁？”
“杨卤对的是……等等，名单改过了？原来他对的是陈峰，怎么换成了赵冲？！”
此言一出，全场哗然。
所有人的目光都投向告示栏，上面的对战名单确实被改动过——杨卤原本对阵陈峰，现在赫然换成了赵冲的名字。
“换人了？谁换的？”
“是赵师兄自己申请的！我听说他昨晚去找了海富长老，要求调整对战顺序！”
“他为什么要换？他想打杨卤？”
“废话！你没听说过吗？赵师兄一直喜欢圣女！杨卤天天给圣女送早餐，还打了圣女一巴掌，赵师兄肯定忍不了啊！”
围观弟子们纷纷议论起来，目光在赵冲和杨卤之间来回跳跃。
果然，赵冲走上高台后，没有去查看自己的对手，而是直接转过身，面向广场上的所有弟子，朗声开口：
“诸位师弟，今日我赵冲主动调整对战名单，目的只有一个——”
他伸出右手，指向人群中的某一个方向。
“杨卤！”
所有人的目光顺着他手指的方向看去，只见杨卤正双手抱胸，靠在告示栏旁边的一根柱子上，表情平静，甚至还带着一丝若有若无的笑意。
赵冲盯着他，声音洪亮而坚定：“你天天往圣女居所跑，打着送早餐的名义骚扰她，甚至还动手打伤了她！这笔账，我一直记在心里！”
他顿了顿，声音陡然拔高：“今天我就要帮圣女讨回公道！在擂台上，我会堂堂正正地击败你，撕碎你那张虚伪的面具，让你知道——有些人，不是你这种货色能招惹的！”
话音落下，广场上瞬间爆发出震天的叫好声。
“好！赵师兄说得好！”
“就该好好教训教训他！让他知道天高地厚！”
“圣女岂是他能染指的？赵师兄，把他打趴下！”
“让他跪地求饶！让他滚出星澜宗！”
弟子们群情激愤，仿佛赵冲的宣言点燃了他们心中积压已久的怨气。毕竟杨卤这三个月来，从山门踹人开始，到天天送早餐打伤圣女，再到立下赌约连赢五场，每一步都在挑战他们对这个世界的认知。
现在终于有人站出来正面迎战了。
赵冲，内门排名前三的天才，二星灵王大圆满，距离三星灵尊只有一步之遥。在他面前，杨卤那点诡异的胜利，总该终结了吧？
content_en:
Early the next morning, the Xinglan Sect Square was crowded with people.
The list of the top sixteen was lined up on the notice board, and Yang Lu's name was clearly on the list, ranked eleventh. Next to it is marked his previous record - five wins and no defeats.
The disciples who were watching looked at this name with complicated expressions.
Some people gritted their teeth, some couldn't believe it, and some were already thinking about how to curse him.
At this moment, a figure strode out of the crowd and walked straight to the high platform in front of the notice board.
Zhao Chong.
He was wearing a dark blue outfit, with clenched fists and sharp eyes, exuding a fierce fighting spirit. His appearance immediately attracted everyone's attention.
"Senior Brother Zhao is here!"
"Who is he going to fight today? The top 16 list is out, who is he going to fight against?"
"I seem to remember...Senior Brother Zhao is dealing with Liu Neng? That guy is really unlucky."
"Then who is Yang Lu right?"
"Yang Lu was right...wait, the list has been changed? It turned out that he was right about Chen Feng, why did he change it to Zhao Chong?!"
As soon as this statement came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
Everyone's eyes turned to the notice board. The battle list on it had indeed been changed - Yang Lu originally played against Chen Feng, but now it was changed to Zhao Chong's name.
"Replaced? Who replaced him?"
"Senior Brother Zhao applied for it himself! I heard that he went to Elder Haifu last night and asked to adjust the battle order!"
"Why does he want to change? Does he want to beat Yang Lu?"
"Nonsense! Haven't you heard? Senior Brother Zhao has always liked the Saint! Yang Lu brings breakfast to the Saint every day and even slaps the Saint. Senior Brother Zhao will definitely not be able to bear it!"
The disciples who were watching started talking one after another, their eyes jumping back and forth between Zhao Chong and Yang Lu.
Sure enough, after Zhao Chong stepped onto the high platform, he did not check his opponent. Instead, he turned around, faced all the disciples in the square, and spoke loudly:
"Junior brothers, today I, Zhao Chong, took the initiative to adjust the battle list for one purpose -"
He stretched out his right hand and pointed in a certain direction among the crowd.
"Yang Lu!"
Everyone looked in the direction of his finger, and saw Yang Luzheng with his arms folded, leaning against a pillar next to the notice board, with a calm expression, and even a hint of a faint smile.
Zhao Chong stared at him, his voice loud and firm: "You run to the saint's residence every day, harassing her in the name of delivering breakfast, and even injured her! I will always keep this account in my heart!"
He paused and his voice suddenly rose: "Today I will help the saint get justice! In the ring, I will defeat you openly and openly, tear your hypocritical mask to pieces, and let you know that there are some people who are not someone like you to mess with!"
As soon as the words fell, the square instantly erupted into loud cheers.
"Okay! Well said, Senior Brother Zhao!"
"You should teach him a lesson! Let him know that the sky is high and the earth is high!"
"How can he get his hands on the Saint? Senior Brother Zhao, knock him down!"
"Let him kneel down and beg for mercy! Let him get out of Xinglan Sect!"
The disciples were furious, as if Zhao Chong's declaration had ignited the long-standing grievances in their hearts. After all, Yang Lu had been challenging their understanding of the world in the past three months, starting from kicking people at the mountain gate, to delivering breakfast every day and injuring the saint, to making a bet to win five games in a row.
Now someone finally stood up and faced it head-on.
Zhao Chong, the top three geniuses in the inner sect, the two-star spiritual king Dzogchen, is only one step away from the three-star spiritual king. In front of him, Yang Lu's weird victory should finally come to an end, right?
title_en: Chapter 18: Zhao Chong goes out to fight and threatens to seek justice. Chapter 17: Winning streak and promotion, everyone unites to plot.
